subject.title: feat(ui): session diff panel showing a session checkout's changes in chat

question: Should `sessions.diff` become a permanent core Gateway protocol method and first-party Control UI review surface?
rationale: Tests can establish implementation correctness, but adding a cross-client protocol capability and broad first-party product surface requires explicit maintainer ownership and direction.

options.title: Accept the core review surface
options.body: Keep the RPC and panel after resource-safety fixes, conflict resolution, exact-head validation, and real-flow proof.

options.title: Narrow to existing surfaces
options.body: Improve the existing workspace and PR-chip review experience without adding a new permanent Gateway method.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not land the implementation until maintainers decide that an integrated diff-review surface belongs in the current roadmap.

recommendation.title: Accept the core review surface
recommendation.body: Keep the RPC and panel after resource-safety fixes, conflict resolution, exact-head validation, and real-flow proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person most directly to the adjacent session PR-chip and chat-sidebar review experience.
